<p>Check-in from 3.00 pm - 7.00 pm<br />Check-out by 11.00 am<br /><span style="font-weight: 400;">Early/late requests subject to availability and may incur additional fees</span></p>
<p><strong>PAYMENTS</strong></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">50% in advance via bank transfer, PIX or credit card. Remaining balance at check-in via bank transfer, PIX or credit card.</span></p>
<p><strong>CANCELLATION</strong></p>
<p>No cancellation fee requested until 60 days prior to arrival.<br />From 59 to 30 days before the arrival: 50% of deposit.<br />From 30 to 1 day  before the arrival: 100% of deposit.</p>
<p><strong>DAMAGE LIABILITY</strong></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Guest is responsible for accidental damages. Property inspection at check-in and check-out. After check-out without damages: authorization canceled within 48–72 hours after check-out.</span></p></div></div></div></div></div><div  class="wrap mcb-wrap mcb-wrap-lume4ng2d one-second
